results.summary_before: This design implements a parallel cellular automaton based on Rule 110, capable of running over 200 cells in parallel each clock cycle. It provides a read/write bus to inspect and modify cell states, with addresses for blocks of 8 cells. The automaton can be halted and resumed, and is intended for exploring complex behavior, pseudo-random number generation, and computation. It requires no external hardware beyond the Tiny Tapeout interface.
